literature.headline_zh: 呼吸道合胞病毒本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期呼吸道合胞病毒研究集中呈现以下进展。
key_findings_zh: 在4,537名患者中,有1,394名感染了RSV,3,143名感染了流感A病毒。在进行微生物学检测的患者中,RSV感染患者中有187/611(30.6%)存在细菌共感染,流感A病毒感染患者中有298/947(31.5%)存在细菌共感染(p = 0.72)。在所有患者中,RSV感染患者中有187/1,394(13.4%)存在细菌共感染,流感A病毒感染患者中有298/3,143(9.5%)存在细菌共感染(p < 0.01)。在两个组中,最常见的病原体是流感嗜血杆菌,其次是肺炎链球菌、卡他莫拉菌和金黄色葡萄球菌。 [10.1007/s15010-026-03036-x]

在MDV 队列研究中,事件后30天内门诊就诊次数平均从1.21次增加到2.07次,住院次数从0.07次增加到0.37次,导致显著增加的医疗费用¥196,231(p < 0.001)。随着时间推移,影响逐渐减弱,在事件后365天期间未检测到统计学显著性。RSV病例数量在研究期间有所增加,分别达到2018–2019年的38例和2019–2020年的36例。 [10.1007/s40801-026-00588-0]

多变量逻辑回归表明,升高的 AAPR 与 G+ 感染的可能性独立且呈负相关(OR = 0.37;95% CI:0.15-0.89,最高与 RCS 分析显示没有非线性关联的证据(非线性 P = 0.456)。单独的 AAPR 显示出适度的判别性能(AUC = 0.599)。将 AAPR 添加到 CRP、WBC、 NEU 将 AUC 从 0.455 增加到 0.613;然而,差异并未达到统计学显着性的常规阈值(P = 0.051)。 [10.1186/s12866-026-05904-w]

在19,021例ALRI住院病例中,有661例(3.5%)为hMPV病例,2397例(12.6%)为RSV病例。hMPV患者年龄较大(中位数为10个月 vs 8个月;P < 0.001),合并症更多(59% vs 47%;P < 0.001),且有更频繁的既往呼吸道住院史(42% vs 20%)。hMPV患者发热更常见(74% vs 65%;P < 0.001),且以局灶性肺炎为主,而毛细支气管炎则较少见。RSV需要更高级的呼吸支持。死亡率的发病率极低且相似。hMPV的高峰晚于RSV。 [10.1097/inf.0000000000005462]
它可引起≥60岁成人及高风险群体的急性呼吸道疾病和下呼吸道感染。在超过24个国家和超过50个医学学会中,普遍推荐对≥60岁人群和免疫功能低下者进行RSV疫苗接种。全球指导趋于一致,优先为老年成人(OAs)和严重疾病高风险人群推荐RSV疫苗接种。 [10.1080/14760584.2026.2755658]
literature.trend_or_risk_zh: 本期研究方向以入选文献实际覆盖的临床、流行病学、宿主生态、诊断或分子监测主题为准。
literature.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following research developments.
key_findings_en: Among 4,537 patients, 1,394 had RSV infection and 3,143 had influenza A infection. Among patients undergoing microbiological testing, bacterial co-infection was identified in 187/611 (30.6%) RSV-infected patients and 298/947 (31.5%) influenza A-infected patients (p = 0.72). [10.1007/s15010-026-03036-x]

In the MDV cohort, the average number of outpatient visits increased from 1.21 to 2.07, and hospitalizations increased from 0.07 to 0.37 within 30 days post-event, resulting in significant additional medical costs of ¥196,231 (p < 0.001). [10.1007/s40801-026-00588-0]

From 2021 to 2024, RSV had the highest incidence rate (63.2/100 person-years [PY]; 95% CI, 56.6-69.8), followed by SARS-CoV-2 (39.3/100 PY; 95% CI, 34.5-44) and influenza (35.7/100 PY; 95% CI, 29-42.3). [10.1128/jvi.00863-26]

Multivariable logistic regression demonstrated that elevated AAPR was independently and inversely associated with the likelihood of G+ infection (OR = 0.37; 95% CI: 0.15–0.89 for the highest vs. RCS analysis showed no evidence of a nonlinear association (P for non-linearity = 0.456). [10.1186/s12866-026-05904-w]

Among 19,021 ALRI hospitalizations, 661 (3.5%) were hMPV and 2397 (12.6%) were RSV cases. hMPV patients were older (median 10 vs 8 months; P < 0.001), had more comorbidities (59% vs 47%; P < 0.001) and had prior respiratory hospitalizations (42% vs 20%). [10.1097/inf.0000000000005462]

papers.title: Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) vaccine recommendations for adults: a review of available global, regional, and country level recommendations
papers.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) can cause serious disease in older adults (OAs), particularly those with underlying medical conditions. It can lead to acute respiratory illness and lower respiratory tract infections in adults ≥60 years and at increased risk groups. RSV morbidity, mortality, and health care burden are increasingly evident. This review aims to equip clinicians with practical guidance to support consistent implementation of RSV vaccination recommendations. AREAS COVERED: We examined global implementation of RSV vaccination recommendations by extracting guidelines from national immunization technical advisory groups, ministries of health, global and regional recommendations, and local medical societies. We categorized guidance by age, risk factors and comorbidities. We compared differences in indications, age thresholds, and frameworks. Across >24 countries and >50 medical societies, a common recommendation supports RSV vaccination in ≥60 years and immunocompromised individuals. The set cutoff date was November 2025. However, significant heterogeneity exists across countries in age threshold indications and risk-based eligibility, as well as in implementation depending on health system infrastructure and resources. EXPERT OPINION: Global guidance converges on prioritizing vaccination for OAs and individuals at high risk of severe disease. By synthesizing worldwide RSV vaccination recommendations, this review offers clinicians an accessible guide to support consistent RSV vaccination.

papers.title: Enhanced respiratory syncytial virus surveillance of young children admitted to the Sydney Children's Hospitals Network, 2019-2023.
papers.abstract: OBJECTIVES: In this study, we aimed to comprehensively describe the clinical characteristics, management and outcomes of children with respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) disease admitted to the Sydney Children's Hospitals Network (SCHN), determine the full burden of severe disease and identify population-specific risk factors for intensive care unit (ICU) admission. STUDY TYPE: Multi-centre, retrospective cohort study conducted over 5 years. METHODS: The study was conducted at two tertiary paediatric hospitals in metropolitan New South Wales, Australia, before implementation of government-funded immunisation programs against RSV in children. Participants were children aged <2 years hospitalised with laboratory-confirmed RSV from 1 January 2019 to 31 December 2023, comprising all ICU admitted, and a random sample of non-ICU admitted patients. The main outcome measures were characteristics and incidence rate of RSV hospitalisations and ICU admissions among children aged <2 years. RESULTS: Over a 5-year period, 4414 children were hospitalised with laboratory-confirmed RSV, of whom 11.3% (499/4414) were admitted to ICU. The median age was younger in the ICU cohort (n = 499) compared with the non-ICU sample (n = 1000; 3.3 vs 7.1 months, P < 0.0001). Factors associated with higher odds of ICU admission in multivariate logistic regression were decreasing month of age (OR 1.10, 95% CI 1.06-1.11), prematurity (OR 2.17, 95% CI 1.61-2.91), Indigenous identity (OR 4.10, 95% CI 2.30-7.56) and cardiac disease (OR 3.39, 95% CI 2.06-5.70). The average hospitalisation incidence rate was 1615 per 100,000 (95% CI 1565-1666), with higher rates among children aged <1 year, 2141 per 100,000 (95% CI 2061-2224) compared with those aged 1-2 years, 1088 per 100,000 (95% CI 1030-1148). CONCLUSIONS: RSV immunisation programs are expected to substantially reduce the burden of hospitalisation among Australian children in their first year of life. Children who are Indigenous, were born prematurely or have heart disease are at greatest risk of severe disease and may benefit from extended preventative programs.

elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 由于研究是在政府资助的疫苗接种计划实施前进行的,因此可能限制其评估此类计划影响的能力。由于研究的回顾性设计以及潜在的未测量混杂因素,证据强度中等。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在全面描述被送往悉尼儿童医院网络的呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)疾病患儿的临床特征、管理及预后,确定严重疾病的总体负担,并识别特定人群进入重症监护病房(ICU)的风险因素。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究是一项在澳大利亚新南威尔士州首府地区两家三级儿科医院进行的为期5年的多中心回顾性研究,是在政府资助的儿童RSV疫苗接种计划实施前开展的。参与者包括2019年1月1日至2023年12月31日期间因实验室确诊RSV而住院的<2岁儿童,包括所有ICU入院患儿以及非ICU入院患儿的随机样本。
analysis_zh.methods: 本研究考察了<2岁儿童RSV住院和ICU入院的特征及发生率。通过多变量逻辑回归分析确定了与ICU入院高风险相关的因素。
analysis_zh.main_results: 5 年期间,4414 名儿童因实验室确诊的 RSV 住院,其中 11.3% (499/4414) 入住 ICU。与非 ICU 样本 (n = 1000;3.3 个月 vs 7.1 个月,P < 0.0001) 相比,ICU 队列研究 中的中位年龄 (n = 499) 更年轻。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将研究结果解释为RSV疫苗接种计划预计会显著降低澳大利亚儿童在出生第一年内的住院负担。他们还指出,原住民儿童、早产儿以及患有心脏疾病的儿童面临最严重的疾病风险,可能从扩展的预防计划中受益。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为制定针对高风险群体(如原住民儿童、早产儿和患有心脏疾病的儿童)的预防计划提供依据,以减少RSV住院的负担。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 由于研究是在政府资助的疫苗接种计划实施前进行的,因此可能限制其评估此类计划影响的能力。由于研究的回顾性设计以及潜在的未测量混杂因素,证据强度中等。

papers.title: Human Metapneumovirus in the Post-pandemic Era:: A Multicenter Comparative Study With Respiratory Syncytial Virus in Argentina, 2022–2025
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Human metapneumovirus (hMPV), identified in 2001, is an important cause of acute lower respiratory infections (ALRI) in children worldwide and is generally considered the second most frequent viral cause after respiratory syncytial virus (RSV). Comparative data between hMPV and RSV in the post-pandemic period remain scarce in Latin America, particularly after the introduction of maternal RSV immunization. METHODS: We conducted a prospective multicenter surveillance study in 5 tertiary pediatric hospitals in Argentina between 2022 and 2025. Children hospitalized with reverse transcription polymerase chain reaction-confirmed hMPV or RSV-associated ALRI were included. Epidemiologic characteristics, clinical presentation, respiratory support requirements, outcomes and seasonal patterns were compared. Independent predictors of hMPV versus RSV infection were evaluated using multivariable logistic regression. RESULTS: Among 19,021 ALRI hospitalizations, 661 (3.5%) were hMPV and 2397 (12.6%) were RSV cases. hMPV patients were older (median 10 vs 8 months; P < 0.001), had more comorbidities (59% vs. 47%; P < 0.001) and had prior respiratory hospitalizations (42% vs. Fever was more frequent in hMPV (74% vs. 65%; P < 0.001), and focal pneumonia predominated over bronchiolitis. RSV required more advanced respiratory support. Mortality was extremely low and comparable. Independent predictors of hMPV included age 6-23 months and prior respiratory hospitalizations; hMPV risk was lower in 2023-2025 versus 2022. hMPV peaked later than RSV. CONCLUSIONS: This emerging respiratory virus demonstrates distinct epidemiologic and clinical characteristics, predominantly affecting older children with respiratory vulnerability. In the era of RSV prevention strategies, hMPV may represent an increasingly important contributor to the residual burden of severe pediatric ALRI, highlighting the need for development of preventive interventions.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 人类副流感病毒(hMPV)是全球儿童急性下呼吸道感染(ALRI)的重要病因,而在后疫情时期,hMPV与呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)之间的比较数据在拉丁美洲仍较为有限,特别是在引入母体RSV免疫接种后。

papers.title: Incidence and risk factors of acute respiratory illness associated with influenza, COVID-19, and respiratory syncytial virus within a birth cohort study
papers.abstract: UNLABELLED: Influenza virus, severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2), and respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) are leading causes of acute respiratory infections (ARIs). New Zealand's coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) public health measures disrupted the circulation of these viruses in 2020-2021, creating a rare opportunity to explore the impact of potential immunity gaps on age-specific infection risk. We analyzed data from 843 participants aged between 0 and 4 years enrolled in the Southern Hemisphere Influenza and Vaccine Effectiveness Research and Surveillance 3 (SHIVERS-III) birth cohort, a longitudinal community-based study in New Zealand, during 2020-2024. During the respiratory season, weekly surveillance captured ARI symptoms and severity. Nasal swabs were collected from symptomatic participants and tested for viral RNA by RT-PCR. Incidence rates (IRs) and incidence rate ratios (IRRs) were estimated for the surveillance period and adjusted for age, sex, ethnic group, socioeconomic status, and influenza vaccination status. No influenza or SARS-CoV-2 infections were detected in 2020 and 2021. From 2021 to 2024, RSV had the highest IR during the surveillance period (63.2/100 person-years [PY]; 95% CI, 56.6-69.8), followed by SARS-CoV-2 (39.3/100 PY; 95% CI, 34.5-44) and influenza (35.7/100 PY; 95% CI, 29-42.3). Age influenced infection risk: infants <6 months had the lowest incidence of influenza and RSV, potentially reflecting maternally derived immunity and limited exposure. Risk increased after 6 months of age, peaking at age 1 year for RSV and at age 2 years for influenza. Influenza vaccination lowered symptomatic influenza risk (IRR 0.66; 95% CI, 0.44-1.00). In the New Zealand community setting in the post-COVID-19 era, individual respiratory virus illness patterns differ in children aged 0-4. Influenza vaccine shows protection, and age influences virus-specific risk. IMPORTANCE: Influenza virus, severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2), and respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) are major causes of acute respiratory illness in early childhood, yet current understanding is largely reliant on hospital-based surveillance that underestimates the broader community burden. This study addresses this limitation by providing comprehensive, community-based estimates of incidence, severity, and symptom profiles across these viruses within a single longitudinal birth cohort. By leveraging the unique epidemiological context created by pandemic-related disruptions, it offers important insights into how changes in exposure influence subsequent infection risk and virus circulation. The direct comparison of three major respiratory viruses within the same population highlights distinct age-related risk patterns and disease characteristics. In addition, our research provides real-world evidence of the reduced risk of influenza-associated acute respiratory illness among vaccinated children. These findings strengthen the evidence base for age-targeted immunization strategies and improve understanding of early-life respiratory virus epidemiology.
authors: on behalf of the SHIVERS Investigation team

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the incidence and risk factors of acute respiratory illness associated with influenza, SARS-CoV-2, and respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) within a birth cohort of children aged 0-4 years in New Zealand. The research highlights the impact of pandemic-related disruptions on viral circulation and provides insights into age-specific infection risks. RSV was found to have the highest incidence rate during the surveillance period, followed by SARS-CoV-2 and influenza. The study also demonstrates that influenza vaccination reduces the risk of symptomatic influenza. The findings suggest that age plays a significant role in infection risk, with infants under 6 months showing lower rates due to potential maternal immunity. These results contribute to the understanding of early-life respiratory virus epidemiology and support the development of age-targeted immunization strategies. The evidence is based on community-based surveillance and is considered moderate in strength due to the absence of reported limitations.

papers.title_zh: 发病率与流感、COVID-19及呼吸道合胞病毒相关急性呼吸道疾病的危险因素:一项出生队列研究研究
papers.source_body_en: UNLABELLED: Influenza virus, severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2), and respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) are leading causes of acute respiratory infections (ARIs). New Zealand's coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) public health measures disrupted the circulation of these viruses in 2020-2021, creating a rare opportunity to explore the impact of potential immunity gaps on age-specific infection risk. We analyzed data from 843 participants aged between 0 and 4 years enrolled in the Southern Hemisphere Influenza and Vaccine Effectiveness Research and Surveillance 3 (SHIVERS-III) birth cohort, a longitudinal community-based study in New Zealand, during 2020-2024. During the respiratory season, weekly surveillance captured ARI symptoms and severity. Nasal swabs were collected from symptomatic participants and tested for viral RNA by RT-PCR. Incidence rates (IRs) and incidence rate ratios (IRRs) were estimated for the surveillance period and adjusted for age, sex, ethnic group, socioeconomic status, and influenza vaccination status. No influenza or SARS-CoV-2 infections were detected in 2020 and 2021. From 2021 to 2024, RSV had the highest IR during the surveillance period (63.2/100 person-years [PY]; 95% CI, 56.6-69.8), followed by SARS-CoV-2 (39.3/100 PY; 95% CI, 34.5-44) and influenza (35.7/100 PY; 95% CI, 29-42.3). Age influenced infection risk: infants <6 months had the lowest incidence of influenza and RSV, potentially reflecting maternally derived immunity and limited exposure. Risk increased after 6 months of age, peaking at age 1 year for RSV and at age 2 years for influenza. Influenza vaccination lowered symptomatic influenza risk (IRR 0.66; 95% CI, 0.44-1.00). In the New Zealand community setting in the post-COVID-19 era, individual respiratory virus illness patterns differ in children aged 0-4. Influenza vaccine shows protection, and age influences virus-specific risk. IMPORTANCE: Influenza virus, severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2), and respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) are major causes of acute respiratory illness in early childhood, yet current understanding is largely reliant on hospital-based surveillance that underestimates the broader community burden. This study addresses this limitation by providing comprehensive, community-based estimates of incidence, severity, and symptom profiles across these viruses within a single longitudinal birth cohort. By leveraging the unique epidemiological context created by pandemic-related disruptions, it offers important insights into how changes in exposure influence subsequent infection risk and virus circulation. The direct comparison of three major respiratory viruses within the same population highlights distinct age-related risk patterns and disease characteristics. In addition, our research provides real-world evidence of the reduced risk of influenza-associated acute respiratory illness among vaccinated children. These findings strengthen the evidence base for age-targeted immunization strategies and improve understanding of early-life respiratory virus epidemiology.

papers.abstract: OBJECTIVES: We estimated human metapneumovirus (hMPV)-associated acute respiratory infection (ARI) hospitalisations in eastern China, and provided a direct comparison with RSV and influenza during 2020-2024. METHODS: Leveraging a large regional medical database, we analysed weekly ARI hospitalisations and viral test-positives (hMPV, RSV and influenza) by age group and region, using negative binomial regression models with natural cubic splines, time-offsets for viral activity, excluding COVID-19 patients and adjusting for COVID-19 waves. RESULTS: hMPV, RSV, and influenza were associated with 100,792 (5.35%), 266,826 (14.17%), and 409,599 (21.76%) ARI hospitalisations, respectively. RSV hospitalisations rebounded first in 2021/2022, followed by hMPV in 2022/2023, while influenza hospitalisations increased annually during the study period; meanwhile, hMPV- and influenza-associated hospitalisations shifted towards those aged 5-19 years, while RSV-associated hospitalisations shifted towards those aged ≥5 years. hMPV rates were highest among infants aged 0-5 months and 6-11 months (6.19 and 8.15 per 1,000 per year on average, respectively), followed by ages 12-23 months (18.54). RSV and influenza rates were highest in age groups within <1 year and 1-4 years, respectively. CONCLUSIONS: Infants aged <1 year are the primary group for preventing severe hMPV infections, with a substantial additional burden observed in children aged 1-4 years. These findings support hMPV vaccine development and virus-specific intervention strategies.

analysis.study_design_and_population: A time-series analysis was conducted using a large regional medical database, examining weekly ARI hospitalisations and viral test-positives for hMPV, RSV, and influenza by age group and region in eastern China from 2020 to 2024.
analysis.methods: Negative binomial regression models with natural cubic splines and time-offsets for viral activity were used, excluding patients with COVID-19 and adjusting for the impact of COVID-19 waves.

analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings highlight the distinct age-related patterns of hMPV and RSV hospitalisations, with hMPV showing a higher burden in infants aged 0-5 months and 6-11 months, and RSV and influenza having higher rates in younger age groups.

analysis.summary_en: This study estimates the hospitalisation rates of human metapneumovirus (hMPV)-associated acute respiratory infections (ARI) in eastern China and compares them with respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) and influenza during 2020-2024. Using a regional medical database and negative binomial regression models, the analysis excludes patients with COVID-19 and adjusts for its impact. Results show hMPV was associated with 100,792 (5.35%) ARI hospitalisations, RSV with 266,826 (14.17%), and influenza with 409,599 (21.76%). RSV hospitalisations rebounded first in 2021/2022, followed by hMPV in 2022/2023, while influenza hospitalisations increased annually. The findings indicate distinct age-related patterns, with hMPV and influenza affecting older children more, and RSV affecting those aged ≥5 years. The study supports the development of hMPV-specific interventions and highlights the need for targeted public health strategies. However, the reliance on a regional database and exclusion of COVID-19 patients may limit generalisability, resulting in moderate confidence in the evidence.

papers.abstract: After reading the letter 1 in response to our article, ''Clinical and economic impact on the primary care system of respiratory syncytial virus infection in children under 5 years'', 2 we would like to make the following comments:We agree that the SARS-CoV-2 pandemic had a substantial impact on the epidemiology of pediatric respiratory infections 3 and that previous infection by this virus could act as a confounder in some studies.However, the objective of our study was not to assess prognostic factors or determinants of severity, but to describe the clinical and economic burden associated with microbiologically confirmed episodes of infection by respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) in real-world everyday clinical practice at the primary care (PC) level.We therefore designed a prospective cohort study in which the exposure variable was microbiological confirmation of RSV infection.The history of infection by SARS-CoV-2 was not uniformly documented in all participants, and, furthermore, more than half of COVID-19 cases in this age group are asymptomatic, 4,5 which precludes reliable classification.The enrollment period (November 2021 to January 2024) coincided with an epidemiological transition period after the pandemic, a circumstance that we addressed in the discussion section of the article as a factor that even affected patient recruitment.We deliberately avoided periods during which COVID-19 cases peaked, which was corroborated by the finding (not published in the original article) that only 12 samples (2.32%) were positive for SARS-CoV-2, with codetection of RSV/SARS-CoV-2 in 3 (0.76%).We have nothing to add to the comments regarding the excessive use of bronchodilators revealed by our study, as

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to describe the clinical and economic burden of microbiologically confirmed respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) infections in real-world primary care settings, addressing the need to understand the impact of RSV on healthcare systems and pediatric populations.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A prospective cohort study was conducted in primary care settings, enrolling participants from November 2021 to January 2024. The exposure variable was microbiological confirmation of RSV infection, and the study focused on children under 5 years of age.
analysis.methods: The study involved the collection of clinical and economic data from primary care records, with microbiological confirmation of RSV infection serving as the exposure variable. The enrollment period was chosen to avoid peak periods of SARS-CoV-2 cases, and the analysis included the examination of codetection with SARS-CoV-2.
analysis.main_results: Only 12 samples (2.32%) were positive for SARS-CoV-2, with codetection of RSV/SARS-CoV-2 in 3 (0.76%) cases. The study highlighted the excessive use of bronchodilators in RSV-related cases.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors acknowledge the impact of the SARS-CoV-2 pandemic on RSV epidemiology and note that the study's focus was on describing the burden of RSV rather than assessing prognostic factors. They emphasize the importance of considering the post-pandemic context in their findings.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings provide insights into the clinical and economic impact of RSV in primary care, which can inform resource allocation and healthcare planning for pediatric respiratory infections.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's design was limited by the lack of uniform documentation of SARS-CoV-2 infection history and the post-pandemic context affecting patient recruitment. The evidence is moderate due to these limitations.

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to describe the clinical and economic burden of microbiologically confirmed respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) infections in primary care settings for children under 5 years. A prospective cohort study was conducted from November 2021 to January 2024, focusing on RSV infection as the exposure variable. The study found that only 12 samples (2.32%) were positive for SARS-CoV-2, with codetection of RSV/SARS-CoV-2 in 3 (0.76%) cases. The authors interpreted these findings as highlighting the excessive use of bronchodilators in RSV-related cases and acknowledged the post-pandemic context affecting the study's design and patient recruitment. The results suggest the need for better resource allocation and healthcare planning for pediatric RSV infections. However, the study's evidence is considered moderate due to limitations in documenting SARS-CoV-2 infection history and the influence of the pandemic on the study's context.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在描述在真实世界初级保健环境中,微生物学确诊的呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)感染的临床和经济负担,以了解RSV对医疗系统和儿科人群的影响。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 在初级保健环境中开展了一项前瞻性队列研究研究,入组时间从2021年11月至2024年1月。暴露变量为RSV感染的微生物学确认,研究聚焦于5岁以下儿童。
elements_zh.methods: 本研究涉及从初级保健记录中收集临床和经济数据,其中RSV感染的微生物学确认作为暴露变量。入组时间的选择是为了避开SARS-CoV-2病例的高峰期,分析包括对RSV与SARS-CoV-2共同检测情况的考察。
elements_zh.main_results: 仅有12份样本(2.32%)检测出SARS-CoV-2阳性,其中RSV/SARS-CoV-2共同检测的有3例(0.76%)。本研究突出了RSV相关病例中支气管扩张剂的过度使用。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者承认SARS-CoV-2大流行对RSV 流行病学的影响,并指出本研究的重点是描述RSV的负担,而非评估预后因素。他们强调在分析结果时应考虑大流行后的背景情况。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现为了解RSV在初级保健中的临床和经济影响提供了见解,有助于为儿科呼吸道感染的医疗资源分配和卫生规划提供依据。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 由于缺乏SARS-CoV-2感染史的统一记录以及大流行后背景对患者招募的影响,本研究的设计存在局限性。这些局限性导致证据强度中等。

They emphasize the importance of considering the post-pandemic context in their findings.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings provide insights into the clinical and economic impact of RSV in primary care, which can inform resource allocation and healthcare planning for pediatric respiratory infections.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's design was limited by the lack of uniform documentation of SARS-CoV-2 infection history and the post-pandemic context affecting patient recruitment. The evidence is moderate due to these limitations.

papers.title_zh: 呼吸道合胞病毒:其在婴儿初级保健中的临床和经济影响反思。作者回复。
papers.source_body_en: After reading the letter 1 in response to our article, ''Clinical and economic impact on the primary care system of respiratory syncytial virus infection in children under 5 years'', 2 we would like to make the following comments:We agree that the SARS-CoV-2 pandemic had a substantial impact on the epidemiology of pediatric respiratory infections 3 and that previous infection by this virus could act as a confounder in some studies.However, the objective of our study was not to assess prognostic factors or determinants of severity, but to describe the clinical and economic burden associated with microbiologically confirmed episodes of infection by respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) in real-world everyday clinical practice at the primary care (PC) level.We therefore designed a prospective cohort study in which the exposure variable was microbiological confirmation of RSV infection.The history of infection by SARS-CoV-2 was not uniformly documented in all participants, and, furthermore, more than half of COVID-19 cases in this age group are asymptomatic, 4,5 which precludes reliable classification.The enrollment period (November 2021 to January 2024) coincided with an epidemiological transition period after the pandemic, a circumstance that we addressed in the discussion section of the article as a factor that even affected patient recruitment.We deliberately avoided periods during which COVID-19 cases peaked, which was corroborated by the finding (not published in the original article) that only 12 samples (2.32%) were positive for SARS-CoV-2, with codetection of RSV/SARS-CoV-2 in 3 (0.76%).We have nothing to add to the comments regarding the excessive use of bronchodilators revealed by our study, as

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在描述在真实世界初级保健环境中,微生物学确诊的呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)感染的临床和经济负担,以了解RSV对医疗系统和儿科人群的影响。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 在初级保健环境中开展了一项前瞻性队列研究研究,入组时间从2021年11月至2024年1月。暴露变量为RSV感染的微生物学确认,研究聚焦于5岁以下儿童。
analysis_zh.methods: 本研究涉及从初级保健记录中收集临床和经济数据,其中RSV感染的微生物学确认作为暴露变量。入组时间的选择是为了避开SARS-CoV-2病例的高峰期,分析包括对RSV与SARS-CoV-2共同检测情况的考察。
analysis_zh.main_results: 仅有12份样本(2.32%)检测出SARS-CoV-2阳性,其中RSV/SARS-CoV-2共同检测的有3例(0.76%)。本研究突出了RSV相关病例中支气管扩张剂的过度使用。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者承认SARS-CoV-2大流行对RSV 流行病学的影响,并指出本研究的重点是描述RSV的负担,而非评估预后因素。他们强调在分析结果时应考虑大流行后的背景情况。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现为了解RSV在初级保健中的临床和经济影响提供了见解,有助于为儿科呼吸道感染的医疗资源分配和卫生规划提供依据。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 由于缺乏SARS-CoV-2感染史的统一记录以及大流行后背景对患者招募的影响,本研究的设计存在局限性。这些局限性导致证据强度中等。

papers.title: Under pressure: lessons learnt from rapid implementation of the respiratory syncytial virus maternal vaccine and infant nirsevimab in Sydney, Australia.
papers.abstract: OBJECTIVE: To share lessons learnt from the Sydney Local Health District (SLHD) rollout of respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) prevention products, and present data on immunisation uptake for mothers and babies in two maternity hospitals. TYPE OF SERVICE: Rollout of the RSV maternal vaccine and the injectable, long-acting monoclonal antibody nirsevimab for newborn infants to protect them from RSV infection and hospitalisation. METHODS: Deidentified summary data from the electronic medical record on RSV immunisation status in two SLHD maternity hospitals were analysed descriptively as counts and proportions. The Consolidated Framework for Implementation Research was used as a lens to reflect on the rollout process. RESULTS: RSV vaccination coverage in women giving birth in two SLHD hospitals improved from 4% in the first month of rollout (February 2025) to a range of 70-74% from June to September 2025. As antenatal coverage improved, the number of live born babies requiring nirsevimab decreased. Among eligible newborns, 36% of families declined nirsevimab, with reason for refusal not recorded. Documentation of RSV immunisation status improved as the rollout progressed. LESSONS LEARNT: Engaging multidisciplinary leaders and clinicians is critical for a coordinated response and program rollout success. Leveraging existing education structures, staff meetings and using online prerecording can optimise clinician education. New programs take time to embed into routine clinical practice, and programs that involve delivering multiple immunisation products for distinct groups require clear messaging and systemic safeguards to prevent errors. Integrating immunisation into medical record workflows as standard practice can support program adoption and uptake.

papers.abstract_zh: 目标:分享悉尼地方卫生区 (SLHD) 推出 呼吸道合胞病毒 (RSV) 预防产品的经验教训,并提供两家妇产医院母亲和婴儿的免疫接种数据。服务类型:推出 RSV 母体 疫苗 和用于新生儿的可注射长效单克隆抗体 尼塞韦单抗,以保护他们免受 RSV 感染和住院治疗。方法:以计数和比例的形式对两家 SLHD 妇产医院的 RSV 免疫状况电子病历中的去识别化汇总数据进行描述性分析。实施研究综合框架被用作反思推出过程的镜头。结果:两家 SLHD 医院分娩妇女的 RSV 疫苗接种 覆盖率从推出第一个月(2025 年 2 月)的 4% 提高到 2025 年 6 月至 9 月的 70-74%。随着产前覆盖率的提高,需要 尼塞韦单抗 的活产婴儿数量减少。在符合条件的新生儿中,36%的家庭拒绝了尼塞韦单抗,但没有记录拒绝的原因。随着推广的进展,RSV 免疫状态的记录得到改善。经验教训:多学科领导者和临床医生的参与对于协调应对和计划成功推出至关重要。利用现有的教育结构、员工会议和使用在线预录音可以优化临床医生教育。新计划需要时间才能融入常规临床实践,而涉及为不同群体提供多种免疫产品的计划需要明确的信息传递和系统保障措施以防止错误。将免疫接种作为标准做法纳入医疗记录工作流程可以支持计划的采用和采用。

papers.title: Bacterial co-infection in patients hospitalized with respiratory syncytial virus and influenza a infection: a retrospective observational cohort study
papers.abstract: PURPOSE: To compare the prevalence, microbiological characteristics, and clinical impact of bacterial co-infection in adults hospitalized with respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) or influenza A infection. METHODS: We conducted a retrospective cohort study of adults hospitalized with laboratory-confirmed RSV or influenza A infection in Central Denmark. Bacterial co-infection was identified using bacterial culturing and urinary antigen testing. Poisson regression was used to estimate risk ratios for bacterial co-infection, and Cox proportional hazards regression was used to evaluate associations between bacterial co-infection and adverse clinical outcomes. RESULTS: Among 4,537 patients, 1,394 had RSV infection and 3,143 had influenza A infection. Among patients undergoing microbiological testing, bacterial co-infection was identified in 187/611 (30.6%) RSV-infected patients and 298/947 (31.5%) influenza A-infected patients (p = 0.72). Among all patients bacterial co-infection was identified in 187/1,394 (13.4%) RSV infected patients and 298/3,143 (9.5%) influenza A infected patients (p < 0.01) Haemophilus influenzae was the most common pathogen in both groups, followed by Streptococcus pneumoniae, Moraxella catarrhalis and Staphylococcus aureus. Bacterial co-infection was associated with increased ICU admission and mortality among influenza A infected patients, whereas estimates were lower in RSV. CONCLUSIONS: Among patients undergoing microbiological testing, bacterial co-infection was identified at similar rates in patients hospitalized with RSV and influenza A infection. The most frequently isolated bacteria in both viral groups were bacterial species harboring genes for beta-lactamase production. These findings support consideration of tailoring the empirical antibiotic therapy to cover pathogens with beta-lactamase production when bacterial co-infection is suspected in RSV and influenza A infected patients. Bacterial co-infection was associated with poorer clinical outcomes in Influenza A than RSV.

The study's large sample size and statistical methods support its findings, though its retrospective design may introduce bias.

papers.abstract_zh: 目的:比较呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)或流感A病毒感染住院成人患者中细菌共感染的流行情况、微生物学特征和临床影响。方法:我们对2015年至2023年间中央丹麦地区实验室确诊的RSV或流感A病毒感染住院成人患者进行了回顾性观察性研究。通过细菌培养和尿液抗原检测确定细菌共感染。使用泊松回归估计细菌共感染的风险比,并使用Cox比例风险回归评估细菌共感染与不良临床结局之间的关联。结果:在4,537名患者中,有1,394名感染了RSV,3,143名感染了流感A病毒。在进行微生物学检测的患者中,RSV感染患者中有187/611(30.6%)存在细菌共感染,流感A病毒感染患者中有298/947(31.5%)存在细菌共感染(p = 0.72)。在所有患者中,RSV感染患者中有187/1,394(13.4%)存在细菌共感染,流感A病毒感染患者中有298/3,143(9.5%)存在细菌共感染(p < 0.01)。在两个组中,最常见的病原体是流感嗜血杆菌,其次是肺炎链球菌、卡他莫拉菌和金黄色葡萄球菌。细菌共感染与流感A病毒感染患者的ICU入院和死亡率增加相关,而在RSV感染患者中估计值较低。结论:在进行微生物学检测的患者中,RSV和流感A病毒感染住院患者中细菌共感染的发生率相似。在两种病毒组中,最常见的分离细菌是携带β-内酰胺酶基因的细菌种类。这些发现支持在怀疑RSV和流感A病毒感染患者存在细菌共感染时,应考虑调整经验性抗生素治疗以覆盖携带β-内酰胺酶基因的病原体。细菌共感染与流感A病毒感染患者的临床结局较差相关,而与RSV感染患者的关联较弱。

analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究是一项在中央丹麦地区2015年至2023年间实验室确诊的RSV或流感A病毒感染住院成人患者中进行的回顾性观察性研究。
analysis_zh.methods: 通过细菌培养和尿液抗原检测确定细菌共感染。使用泊松回归估计细菌共感染的风险比,并使用Cox比例风险回归评估细菌共感染与不良临床结局之间的关联。
analysis_zh.main_results: 在4,537名患者中,有1,394名感染了RSV,3,143名感染了流感A病毒。在进行微生物学检测的患者中,RSV感染患者中有187/611(30.6%)存在细菌共感染,流感A病毒感染患者中有298/947(31.5%)存在细菌共感染(p = 0.72)。在所有患者中,RSV感染患者中有187/1,394(13.4%)存在细菌共感染,流感A病毒感染患者中有298/3,143(9.5%)存在细菌共感染(p < 0.01)。在两个组中,最常见的病原体是流感嗜血杆菌,其次是肺炎链球菌、卡他莫拉菌和金黄色葡萄球菌。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,RSV和流感A病毒感染住院患者中细菌共感染的发生率相似,且在两种病毒组中,最常见的分离细菌是携带β-内酰胺酶基因的细菌种类。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果表明,当怀疑RSV和流感A病毒感染患者存在细菌共感染时,经验性抗生素治疗应考虑覆盖携带β-内酰胺酶基因的病原体。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性在于其回顾性设计和可能的选择偏倚,但由于样本量大且使用统计方法评估关联,证据是强有力的。

papers.title: Aspergillus species isolation in respiratory samples from patients with respiratory syncytial virus: An 11-year retrospective single-center cohort study.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Respiratory syncytial virus is a significant cause of morbidity in adults, but data on fungal coinfections, beyond influenza-associated pulmonary aspergillosis and COVID-19-associated pulmonary aspergillosis, remain limited. AIMS: To characterize the isolation of Aspergillus in respiratory samples from adult patients with confirmed respiratory syncytial virus infection over an 11-year period, and to describe associated risk factors, microbiological findings, antifungal treatment, and clinical outcomes. METHODS: We conducted an 11-year retrospective study at Hospital Universitario La Paz (Madrid, Spain) including 17 adult patients with confirmed respiratory syncytial virus infection and Aspergillus isolation from respiratory samples. Episodes were classified as probable invasive aspergillosis or colonization according to clinical, radiological, and microbiological findings. RESULTS: A total of 18 episodes were identified, with the species within the Aspergillus fumigatus complex being the most frequently isolated (78.9%), followed by Aspergillus terreus complex (10.5%), Aspergillus nidulans complex (5.3%), and Aspergillus niger complex (5.3). Most isolates were considered colonization (55.6%), while probable invasive aspergillosis accounted for 44.4% episodes, based on compatible clinical and radiological findings. Corticosteroid exposure was common with 82.4% receiving or starting a corticosteroid therapy during hospitalization, and antifungal therapy was administered in 44.4% of episodes, including voriconazole and liposomal amphotericin B. The median hospital stay was 16 days (IQR: 8-28). Mortality was 11.1%. CONCLUSIONS: Aspergillus isolation in adults with respiratory syncytial virus infection was observed mainly in patients with underlying pulmonary disease or comorbidities, with colonization being more frequent than invasive aspergillosis. However, no episodes of severe invasive aspergillosis requiring intensive care were observed in this cohort. Our study provides novel insights into Aspergillus isolation associated with respiratory syncytial virus infection and emphasizes the need for further multicentric studies to define epidemiology, risk factors, and optimal management strategies.

Conducted at Hospital Universitario La Paz in Madrid, Spain, it included 17 patients with RSV infection and Aspergillus isolation. The study classified episodes as colonization or probable invasive aspergillosis based on clinical, radiological, and microbiological findings. Results showed that the Aspergillus fumigatus complex was most frequently isolated (78.9%), followed by other species. However, no severe invasive aspergillosis cases requiring intensive care were observed, which may limit the generalizability of findings.

papers.title: Decision-Making About Respiratory Syncytial Virus Immunization for Infants: Qualitative Interview Study
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) is the leading cause of infant hospitalization in the United States. Although maternal RSV vaccination and infant RSV monoclonal antibody products are recommended to protect infants during their first RSV season, uptake has remained modest. Understanding how pregnant individuals make decisions about these products is critical for informing strategies that support timely immunization. Objective The study aimed to examine the behavioral and social drivers shaping decisions regarding RSV vaccination during pregnancy and infant RSV monoclonal antibody immunization among pregnant individuals in the United States. Methods We conducted an exploratory qualitative study from a relativist epistemological perspective, using semistructured interviews with 12 pregnant and postpartum adults recruited across the United States between October 2024 and May 2025. Participants were purposively sampled to include individuals with positive, uncertain, and negative intentions toward RSV vaccination. Interviews were guided by the World Health Organization’s behavioral and social drivers of vaccination framework and analyzed using a framework analysis approach. Screening survey data were summarized descriptively to characterize participant immunization intentions and contextualize the qualitative findings. Results RSV immunization decisions reflected interacting behavioral, emotional, social, and practical influences rather than attitudes alone. Participants with positive vaccination intentions described greater trust in medical expertise, confidence in vaccination, and personal or professional experience with RSV illness. Those with unsure or negative intentions emphasized the novelty of RSV vaccines, concerns about safety and long-term effects, and greater reliance on clinician recommendations and peer experiences when making decisions. Across intention groups, participants expressed a preference for receiving protection during pregnancy rather than after birth but reported uncertainty related to vaccine availability, timing within the 32- to 36-week eligibility window, and inconsistent integration into prenatal care. Participants consistently identified trusted clinician communication, opportunities for early discussion, and access to clear educational materials as important influences on decision-making. Conclusions Decisions regarding RSV immunization during pregnancy are shaped by interconnected motivational, interpersonal, and structural factors. Integrating education on RSV and RSV immunization options earlier in prenatal care, strengthening clinician recommendations, and reducing logistical barriers to maternal vaccination may improve informed decision-making and timely uptake of infant RSV protection.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)是美国婴儿住院的主要原因。本研究旨在探讨影响美国孕妇在怀孕期间以及婴儿RSV单克隆抗体免疫决策的行为和社会驱动因素。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 我们从相对主义认识论的角度开展了一项探索性的定性研究,使用半结构化访谈,访谈对象为12名在美国各州招募的孕妇和产后成人,招募时间从2024年10月至2025年5月。访谈基于世界卫生组织的疫苗接种框架的行为和社会驱动因素,并采用框架分析方法进行分析。筛查调查数据被描述性总结,以描述参与者的疫苗接种意图,并为定性发现提供背景。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: RSV免疫决策反映了行为、情感、社会和实际因素的相互作用,而不仅仅是态度。参与者一致认为,值得信赖的临床医生沟通、早期讨论的机会以及获取清晰教育材料的途径是影响决策的重要因素。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 具有不确定或消极意图的参与者强调了RSV 疫苗的新颖性、对安全性和长期影响的担忧,以及在决策过程中更依赖临床医生的建议和同龄人的经验。在所有意图群体中,参与者表达了在怀孕期间接受保护的偏好,而不是出生后,但报告了关于RSV 疫苗供应情况、在32至36周资格窗口内的接种时间以及其在产前护理中整合不一致的不确定性。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 在产前护理早期整合RSV及其免疫选项的教育,加强临床医生的建议,并减少母体RSV 疫苗接种的后勤障碍,可能会改善知情决策并促进婴儿RSV保护的及时接种。

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)是美国婴儿住院的主要原因。尽管推荐孕妇使用RSV疫苗和婴儿RSV单克隆抗体产品以保护婴儿在首次RSV季节期间免受感染,但接种率一直保持在较低水平。了解孕妇在这些产品上的决策过程对于制定支持及时免疫策略至关重要。目的 本研究旨在探讨影响美国孕妇在怀孕期间以及婴儿RSV单克隆抗体免疫决策的行为和社会驱动因素。方法 我们从相对主义认识论的角度出发,开展了一项探索性的定性研究,通过半结构化访谈收集了12名来自美国不同地区的孕妇和产后成年人的数据,访谈时间从2024年10月至2025年5月。参与者根据其对RSV疫苗的积极、不确定和消极意向进行目的性抽样。访谈基于世界卫生组织关于RSV疫苗的行为和社会驱动因素框架进行指导,并采用框架分析方法进行分析。筛查调查数据被描述性总结,以表征参与者的免疫意向并为定性发现提供背景。结果 RSV免疫决策反映了行为、情感、社会和实际因素的相互作用,而不仅仅是态度本身。具有积极意向的参与者描述了对医疗专业知识更大的信任、对RSV疫苗的信心以及个人或职业经历中与RSV疾病相关的经验。那些具有不确定或消极意向的参与者则强调了RSV疫苗的新颖性、对其安全性和长期影响的担忧,以及在决策过程中更依赖于医生的建议和同龄人的经验。在所有意向组中,参与者普遍更倾向于在怀孕期间接受保护,而不是在出生后,但报告了关于RSV疫苗供应、在32至36周内接种时间窗口的安排以及其在产前护理中整合不一致的不确定性。参与者一致认为,值得信赖的医生沟通、早期讨论的机会以及获取清晰教育材料的途径是影响决策的重要因素。结论 怀孕期间的RSV免疫决策受到相互关联的动机、人际和结构性因素的影响。在产前护理早期整合RSV及其免疫选项的教育内容、加强医生的建议以及减少孕妇接种RSV疫苗的后勤障碍,可能有助于改善知情决策和及时的婴儿RSV保护接种率。

papers.title: Binding antibodies against respiratory syncytial virus and association with age-specific neutralizing antibodies and hospitalization patterns in Israel
papers.abstract: Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV) imposes a substantial health burden, particularly in infants and older adults, but comprehensive population-level data describing age-specific antibody responses alongside hospitalization patterns are scarce. To assess RSV seropositivity across demographic and geographic variables, to evaluate age-specific binding and neutralizing antibody responses, and to describe the age distribution of RSV-positive hospitalizations in an independent hospitalized cohort; any comparisons between the serosurvey and the hospitalized cohort are descriptive and hypothesis‐generating. A cross-sectional sero-survey of 1,396 sera samples was conducted to measure RSV binding antibodies using ELISA (values were defined as high-positive, borderline or low-positive). Of them, neutralizing antibodies were assessed in 243 age-stratified sera. An independent cohort of 1,232 RSV-positive hospitalized patients collected during the 2022–2025 winter seasons at a single center was used to evaluate age-specific hospitalization distributions; the two datasets were not linked at the individual level. Overall, the RSV high-seropositivity rate was 7.8%, with infants aged 0–12 months showing the lowest seroprevalence (0.0%) while children aged 13–59 months (15.4%) and adults aged ≥ 60 years (12.9%) showed the highest. RSV geometric mean titers (GMTs) differed significantly by age, increasing from infancy to adulthood and peaking in those aged ≥ 60 years ( p < 0.0001). Higher GMTs were observed among individuals born outside Israel and varied significantly by district, with the highest levels in the South and lowest in Tel Aviv. Among the hospitalized cohort, infants accounted for the largest proportion of RSV-positive hospitalizations (35.3%), followed by adults aged ≥ 60 years (25.4%). These age‐specific patterns are reported for independent datasets and any juxtaposition is descriptive. Neutralizing antibody analysis in 243 age-stratified sera demonstrated strong correlations between binding and neutralizing antibodies in infants and young children, but weak to moderate correlations in older age groups. Age-specific differences in both the quantity and functional quality of antibodies were observed, with marked demographic variation. Because the serosurvey and hospitalized cohort are independent, the observed concordance or discordance between antibody patterns and hospitalization distribution is descriptive and does not establish causality. analysis_zh.methods: 进行了一项横断面血清学调查,共收集了1,396份血清样本,通过ELISA检测RSV结合抗体(值被定义为高阳性、临界或低阳性)。其中,对243份按年龄分层的血清样本进行了中和抗体评估。
analysis_zh.main_results: 总体而言,RSV高血清阳性率为7.8%,其中0–12个月的婴儿显示出最低的血清流行率(0.0%),而13–59个月的儿童(15.4%)和≥60岁的成年人(12.9%)则显示出最高水平。RSV几何平均滴度(GMTs)在不同年龄组间存在显著差异,从婴儿期到成年期逐渐上升,并在≥60岁的人群中达到峰值(p < 0.0001)。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 在抗体的数量和功能质量方面观察到了年龄特异性差异,并且存在显著的人口统计学差异。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现强调了针对高风险群体(如婴儿和老年人)制定特定疫苗接种和预防策略的必要性。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 由于血清调查和住院队列研究是独立的,因此观察到的抗体模式与住院分布之间的符合或不符合仅是描述性的,不能建立因果关系。

papers.title: Subconjunctival Hemorrhage and Respiratory Syncytial Virus Infection in an Infant Evaluated for Non-accidental Trauma: A Case Report of a Possible Association
papers.abstract: A six-week-old previously healthy infant was found to have a subconjunctival hemorrhage (SCH) and concomitant respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) infection.Because SCH in an infant may represent a sentinel finding of non-accidental trauma (NAT), an extensive multidisciplinary evaluation was performed, which identified no traumatic injuries or evidence of abuse.The SCH resolved within one week, and the patient recovered with supportive care without complications.To our knowledge, SCH in association with RSV has not previously been reported, despite RSV being common in infants.As with SCH reported in association with other respiratory infections, inflammatory and pressure-related processes are possible mechanisms, although this observational case cannot establish causation.Reporting this possible association may broaden the differential diagnosis of SCH to include other medical causes in infants with RSV, while reinforcing the need for completing a thorough screening for abuse.Identifying medical causes for childhood injuries is as important as accurately diagnosing inflicted injury, as misdiagnosing child abuse can have serious medicolegal consequences for children and their families.

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to explore the potential association between subconjunctival hemorrhage (SCH) and respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) infection in an infant, as SCH may be a sentinel finding for non-accidental trauma (NAT).
analysis.study_design_and_population: A case report was conducted on a six-week-old infant with a subconjunctival hemorrhage and concomitant RSV infection, evaluated for possible non-accidental trauma.
analysis.methods: An extensive multidisciplinary evaluation was performed to assess for traumatic injuries or evidence of abuse, including clinical examination and diagnostic testing for RSV infection.
analysis.main_results: The infant had a subconjunctival hemorrhage and RSV infection, but no traumatic injuries or evidence of abuse were found. The SCH resolved within one week, and the patient recovered with supportive care without complications.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors suggest that while inflammatory and pressure-related processes may explain the association between SCH and RSV, this observational case cannot establish causation. This case report highlights a possible association that has not been previously documented.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings may inform the differential diagnosis of SCH in infants with RSV, emphasizing the importance of considering medical causes alongside potential inflicted injuries.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its observational nature and lack of control groups, which prevents establishing causation. The evidence is considered moderate due to these limitations.

analysis.summary_en: This case report describes a six-week-old infant with subconjunctival hemorrhage (SCH) and respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) infection who was evaluated for non-accidental trauma. Despite the presence of SCH, which can be a sentinel finding for abuse, no traumatic injuries or evidence of abuse were identified. The SCH resolved within a week, and the infant recovered with supportive care. The authors note that this is the first reported association between SCH and RSV, suggesting possible mechanisms such as inflammation or pressure-related processes, although causation cannot be established. The case underscores the importance of considering medical causes for childhood injuries and highlights the need for thorough screening for abuse in infants with RSV. The study's limitations include its observational design and lack of control groups, resulting in moderate evidence strength.

papers.title: 06 | Nirsevimab as a key strategy to prevent respiratory syncytial virus among newborns and children: real-world evidence from Italy and Sicily
papers.abstract: Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) is one of the leading causes of lower respiratory tract infections and hospitalization during the first year of life. The introduction of the next-generation long-acting monoclonal antibody Nirsevimab across the Italian Regions, starting from the 2024/25 season, has substantially changed RSV prevention. Administered as a single dose, Nirsevimab has extended protection to all infants during their first RSV season, thereby overcoming the main limitations associated with Palivizumab. Materials and Methods. A non-systematic review of the scientific literature was conducted, focusing on real-world effectiveness (RWE) studies carried out in Italy following the introduction of Nirsevimab during the 2024/2025 season. The main outcomes analyzed included hospitalizations, disease severity, and admissions to intensive care units (ICUs). Real-world effectiveness data available in the scientific literature from different Italian regions have confirmed the high effectiveness of Nirsevimab observed in clinical trials, in line with findings reported in the international literature. A recent meta-analysis of 27 studies conducted in Europe and the United States estimated an 83% reduction in hospitalizations, an 81% reduction in intensive care unit admissions, and a 75% reduction in the incidence of RSV lower respiratory tract infections (LRTIs). Studies conducted in Italy have reported immunization effectiveness in real-world settings exceeding 85% in preventing severe RSV disease, over 80% in preventing RSV-related hospitalizations in neonatal intensive care units (NICUs) or pediatric wards, and over 70% in preventing emergency department visits for RSV-related illness. Studies based on Italian and Sicilian Hospital Discharge Records have also shown that RSV-related hospitalizations were more than halved during the first season of monoclonal antibody use across different Italian regions, including Sicily. The Italian experience suggests that Nirsevimab represents a paradigm shift in the natural history of RSV disease, with a substantial impact on both the hospital and community healthcare burden. The effectiveness of Nirsevimab can translate into a meaningful public health benefit only if high immunization coverage is achieved, ensuring protection for both in-season and out-of-season births, the latter currently representing a key challenge, with lower uptake rates. It is also important to document informed parental refusal among those who decline prophylaxis and to ensure re-immunization during the second RSV season for vulnerable children (i.e., the former palivizumab-eligible cohort). Furthermore, RespivirNet surveillance data should guide the definition of the immunization window on an annual basis, including consideration of a possible extension of immunization at birth through April 30, in view of the progressively later onset of RSV circulation at both the community and hospital levels, particularly in Southern Italian regions. In summary, nirsevimab represents not merely a new preventive strategy, but a paradigm shift: a true revolution in RSV prevention. The project is part of the Italian Complementary National Plan PNC-I.1 ”Research initiatives for innovative technologies and pathways in the health and welfare sector” D.D. 931 of 06/06/2022, ”DARE - DigitAl lifelong pRevEn-tion” initiative, “Digivax” Pilot Project - code PNC0000002, CUP: B53C22006460001.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)是导致婴儿第一年生命中下呼吸道感染和住院的主要原因之一。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 对科学文献进行了非系统性回顾,重点分析了意大利在2024/2025赛季引入尼塞韦单抗后进行的现实世界有效性(RWE)研究。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 意大利不同地区的现实世界有效性数据证实了尼塞韦单抗在临床试验中观察到的高有效性,与国际文献报道的结果一致。意大利的研究表明,在现实世界中,尼塞韦单抗的免疫有效性超过85%可预防严重的RSV疾病,超过80%可预防新生儿重症监护病房(NICUs)或儿科病房中的RSV相关住院,超过70%可预防RSV相关疾病的急诊科就诊。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 只有在实现高疫苗接种覆盖率的情况下,尼塞韦单抗的有效性才能转化为有意义的公共卫生效益,确保对季节内和季节外出生的婴儿均提供保护,后者目前是主要挑战,接种率较低。此外,还需要记录那些拒绝预防措施的知情家长的拒绝情况,并确保对易感儿童(即以前符合帕利珠单抗接种条件的婴儿)在第二次RSV季节中进行再次接种。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 此外,RespivirNet尼塞韦单抗数据应指导每年疫苗接种窗口的定义,包括考虑在出生时将疫苗接种时间延长至4月30日,以应对RSV在社区和医院层面传播时间逐渐推迟的趋势,尤其是在意大利南部地区。总之,尼塞韦单抗不仅代表了一种新的预防策略,更是一种范式转变:RSV预防领域的一场真正革命。

papers.title_zh: 06 | 尼塞韦单抗作为预防新生儿和儿童呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)感染的关键策略:意大利和西西里地区的现实证据
papers.source_body_en: Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) is one of the leading causes of lower respiratory tract infections and hospitalization during the first year of life. The introduction of the next-generation long-acting monoclonal antibody Nirsevimab across the Italian Regions, starting from the 2024/25 season, has substantially changed RSV prevention. Administered as a single dose, Nirsevimab has extended protection to all infants during their first RSV season, thereby overcoming the main limitations associated with Palivizumab. Materials and Methods. A non-systematic review of the scientific literature was conducted, focusing on real-world effectiveness (RWE) studies carried out in Italy following the introduction of Nirsevimab during the 2024/2025 season. The main outcomes analyzed included hospitalizations, disease severity, and admissions to intensive care units (ICUs). Real-world effectiveness data available in the scientific literature from different Italian regions have confirmed the high effectiveness of Nirsevimab observed in clinical trials, in line with findings reported in the international literature. A recent meta-analysis of 27 studies conducted in Europe and the United States estimated an 83% reduction in hospitalizations, an 81% reduction in intensive care unit admissions, and a 75% reduction in the incidence of RSV lower respiratory tract infections (LRTIs). Studies conducted in Italy have reported immunization effectiveness in real-world settings exceeding 85% in preventing severe RSV disease, over 80% in preventing RSV-related hospitalizations in neonatal intensive care units (NICUs) or pediatric wards, and over 70% in preventing emergency department visits for RSV-related illness. Studies based on Italian and Sicilian Hospital Discharge Records have also shown that RSV-related hospitalizations were more than halved during the first season of monoclonal antibody use across different Italian regions, including Sicily. The Italian experience suggests that Nirsevimab represents a paradigm shift in the natural history of RSV disease, with a substantial impact on both the hospital and community healthcare burden. The effectiveness of Nirsevimab can translate into a meaningful public health benefit only if high immunization coverage is achieved, ensuring protection for both in-season and out-of-season births, the latter currently representing a key challenge, with lower uptake rates. It is also important to document informed parental refusal among those who decline prophylaxis and to ensure re-immunization during the second RSV season for vulnerable children (i.e., the former palivizumab-eligible cohort). Furthermore, RespivirNet surveillance data should guide the definition of the immunization window on an annual basis, including consideration of a possible extension of immunization at birth through April 30, in view of the progressively later onset of RSV circulation at both the community and hospital levels, particularly in Southern Italian regions. In summary, nirsevimab represents not merely a new preventive strategy, but a paradigm shift: a true revolution in RSV prevention. The project is part of the Italian Complementary National Plan PNC-I.1 ”Research initiatives for innovative technologies and pathways in the health and welfare sector” D.D. 931 of 06/06/2022, ”DARE - DigitAl lifelong pRevEn-tion” initiative, “Digivax” Pilot Project - code PNC0000002, CUP: B53C22006460001.

papers.title: A ciliated epithelial cell line as a model for respiratory syncytial virus research
papers.abstract: Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) is the leading cause of severe respiratory infection in infants and an increasingly recognized pathogen in the elderly. Conventional in vitro culture models for RSV rely on poorly differentiated cell lines that lack key airway epithelial features such as polarization, tight junctions and cilia, despite ciliated cells being the main RSV target. Primary airway epithelial cultures better reflect in vivo conditions, but they are difficult to access. We evaluated the human bronchial epithelial cell line BCi-NS1.1 differentiated at an air-liquid interface (ALI) as an alternative model. Three weeks after ALI, BCi-NS1.1 cultures exhibited advanced differentiation, including mature tight junctions, IL-13-induced MUC5AC production, a transepithelial potential difference of around −20 mV and 19% ciliated cells. These cultures expressed CX3CR1 receptor in cilia, which may serve as an entry point for RSV. These cultures were readily infected by RSV from the apical side, with infected cell numbers increasing from day 1 to day 5 post-infection. Apical viral titres reached ~2×10 5 PFU ml −1 between day 2 and day 4. Infection led to the formation of typical viral factories with inclusion-body-associated granules, apical release of new infectious virions and controlled shedding of infected cells. Because shedding limits subcellular analysis, we generated an RSV lacking NS2, a protein promoting cell rounding and shedding. Cells infected with RSV-Delta NS2 exhibited slower shedding and maintained their shape longer, enabling visualization of ribonucleoprotein migration towards and across the apical membrane. Overall, ALI-differentiated BCi-NS1.1 cells provide a suitable tool for studying epithelial responses to RSV infection.

We evaluated the human bronchial epithelial cell line BCi-NS1.1 differentiated at an air-liquid interface (ALI) as an alternative model. Three weeks after ALI, BCi-NS1.1 cultures exhibited advanced differentiation, including mature tight junctions, IL-13-induced MUC5AC production, a transepithelial potential difference of around −20 mV and 19% ciliated cells. These cultures expressed CX3CR1 receptor in cilia, which may serve as an entry point for RSV. These cultures were readily infected by RSV from the apical side, with infected cell numbers increasing from day 1 to day 5 post-infection. Apical viral titres reached ~2×10 5 PFU ml −1 between day 2 and day 4. Infection led to the formation of typical viral factories with inclusion-body-associated granules, apical release of new infectious virions and controlled shedding of infected cells. Because shedding limits subcellular analysis, we generated an RSV lacking NS2, a protein promoting cell rounding and shedding. Cells infected with RSV-Delta NS2 exhibited slower shedding and maintained their shape longer, enabling visualization of ribonucleoprotein migration towards and across the apical membrane. Overall, ALI-differentiated BCi-NS1.1 cells provide a suitable tool for studying epithelial responses to RSV infection.

papers.abstract_zh: 呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)是婴儿严重呼吸道感染的主要原因,并且在老年人中逐渐被认可为一种病原体。尽管纤毛细胞是RSV的主要靶标,但传统的RSV体外培养模型依赖于分化不良的细胞系,这些细胞系缺乏极化、紧密连接和纤毛等关键气道上皮特征。原代气道上皮培养更贴近体内环境,但获取较为困难。本研究评估了在气液界面(ALI)分化的人支气管上皮细胞系BCi-NS1.1作为RSV研究的替代模型。在ALI分化三周后,BCi-NS1.1培养物表现出高级分化特征,包括成熟的紧密连接、IL-13诱导的MUC5AC产生、约−20 mV的跨上皮电位差以及19%的纤毛细胞比例。这些培养物在纤毛上表达CX3CR1受体,这可能为RSV的入侵提供途径。RSV可以从顶端感染这些培养物,感染细胞数量在感染后第1天至第5天持续增加。感染后第2至第4天,顶端病毒滴度达到约2×10^5 PFU ml^{-1}。感染导致形成典型的病毒工厂,包括与包涵体相关的颗粒、顶端释放新的感染性病毒颗粒以及受感染细胞的受控脱落。由于脱落限制了亚细胞分析,我们生成了一种缺乏NS2蛋白(该蛋白促进细胞圆化和脱落)的RSV,以促进亚细胞分析。感染RSV-Delta NS2的细胞表现出较慢的脱落,并且在更长时间内保持其形态,从而能够观察到核糖核蛋白向顶端膜迁移的现象。总体而言,ALI分化的BCi-NS1.1细胞为研究RSV感染对上皮反应提供了合适的工具。

papers.title: 01 | Integrated prevention of respiratory syncytial virus in infants after the “revolution”: reflections from the first two seasons in Sicily and Calabria
papers.abstract: The introduction of maternal immunization and monoclonal antibody prophylaxis has substantially changed the prevention of respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) disease in infants. After two seasons of implementation, the experience of Sicily and Calabria offers an opportunity to discuss the clinical impact of these strategies and the organisational challenges involved in their delivery. Materials and Methods. This narrative contribution is based on a structured discussion with two healthcare professionals involved in RSV prevention. The first perspective concerns the paediatric impact of the new strategies, including changes in hospital admissions, disease severity and the characteristics of infants who continue to require hospital care. The second focuses on maternal immunization, with particular reference to acceptance among pregnant women, communication needs and the integration of vaccination into birth pathways. The first two seasons suggest a substantial reduction in the burden of severe RSV disease. In Sicily, during the 2024–2025 season, more than 65% of the target population received preventive protection and hospitalizations for RSV bronchiolitis decreased by approximately 40%. However, residual hospitalizations continue to occur, particularly among infants who did not receive timely prophylaxis, very young infants and children with underlying vulnerability. From the perspective of maternal immunization, the main challenges concern the timely identification of eligible women, the coordination between maternity units and vaccination services, and the consistency of information provided by healthcare professionals. Acceptance may be influenced by organisational barriers as well as by communication and cultural factors. The experience of the first two seasons indicates that the effectiveness of RSV prevention depends not only on the availability of maternal immunization and monoclonal antibody prophylaxis, but also on the ability to integrate these interventions into routine care pathways. Strengthening collaboration among maternity units, vaccination services, paediatricians and community healthcare professionals will be essential to improve timely access, reduce residual preventable disease and ensure equitable protection for infants in Sicily and Calabria.

elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 证据基础来源于基于结构化讨论的叙述性综述,讨论对象为两位参与RSV预防的医疗专业人员。综述未报告具体数据库、检索日期或元分析方法,但包含了对研究设计和人群的一般描述。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 前两个季节的实施表明,严重RSV疾病的负担显著减少。RSV预防策略的有效性不仅取决于母体免疫接种和单克隆抗体预防措施的可获得性,还取决于这些干预措施能否整合到常规护理路径中。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 残留住院病例仍持续发生,尤其是在未及时接受预防措施的婴儿、非常年幼的婴儿以及有潜在脆弱性的儿童中。综述强调了在及时识别符合条件的孕妇、产科单位与疫苗接种服务之间的协调以及医疗专业人员提供信息一致性方面的挑战。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 加强产科单位、疫苗接种服务、儿科医生和社区医疗专业人员之间的合作将是提高及时获取服务、减少残留可预防疾病以及确保西西里和卡拉布里亚婴儿公平保护的关键。

papers.abstract_zh: 母体免疫接种和单克隆抗体预防措施的引入已显著改变了婴儿呼吸道合胞病毒(呼吸道合胞病毒RSV)疾病的预防方式。在实施了两个季节后,西西里和卡拉布里亚的经验为讨论这些策略的临床影响以及其在实施过程中所涉及的组织挑战提供了机会。材料与方法。本叙述性贡献基于与两位参与RSV预防的医疗专业人员进行的结构化讨论。第一视角关注新策略对儿科的影响,包括住院人数的变化、疾病严重程度以及仍需住院治疗的婴儿特征。第二视角聚焦于母体免疫接种,特别涉及孕妇的接受度、沟通需求以及将呼吸道合胞病毒纳入分娩路径的整合情况。前两个季节表明,严重RSV疾病的负担显著减少。在西西里,2024–2025赛季中,超过65%的目标人群接受了预防保护,RSV 呼吸道合胞病毒相关的住院人数减少了约40%。然而,仍有残留住院病例,尤其是在未及时接受预防措施的婴儿、非常年幼的婴儿以及有潜在脆弱性的儿童中。从母体免疫接种的角度来看,主要挑战涉及及时识别符合条件的孕妇、产科单位与疫苗接种服务之间的协调,以及医疗专业人员提供的信息一致性。接受度可能受到组织障碍以及沟通和文化因素的影响。前两个季节的经验表明,RSV预防的效果不仅取决于母体免疫接种和单克隆抗体预防措施的可获得性,还取决于这些干预措施能否整合到常规护理路径中。加强产科单位、疫苗接种服务、儿科医生和社区医疗专业人员之间的合作将是提高及时获取服务、减少残留可预防疾病以及确保西西里和卡拉布里亚婴儿公平保护的关键。

analysis_zh.scope_and_question: 本综述聚焦于婴儿呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)疾病的预防,特别是在引入母体免疫接种和单克隆抗体预防措施之后。核心问题是这些新策略如何影响西西里和卡拉布里亚的临床结果和组织挑战。
analysis_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 证据基础来源于基于结构化讨论的叙述性综述,讨论对象为两位参与RSV预防的医疗专业人员。综述未报告具体数据库、检索日期或元分析方法,但包含了对研究设计和人群的一般描述。
analysis_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 前两个季节的实施表明,严重RSV疾病的负担显著减少。RSV预防策略的有效性不仅取决于母体免疫接种和单克隆抗体预防措施的可获得性,还取决于这些干预措施能否整合到常规护理路径中。
analysis_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 残留住院病例仍持续发生,尤其是在未及时接受预防措施的婴儿、非常年幼的婴儿以及有潜在脆弱性的儿童中。综述强调了在及时识别符合条件的孕妇、产科单位与疫苗接种服务之间的协调以及医疗专业人员提供信息一致性方面的挑战。
analysis_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 加强产科单位、疫苗接种服务、儿科医生和社区医疗专业人员之间的合作将是提高及时获取服务、减少残留可预防疾病以及确保西西里和卡拉布里亚婴儿公平保护的关键。
